lead: `tungstenite` refuses a `101` that chose an unoffered subprotocol before Novis sees it.
body: Its handshake compares the reply's `Sec-WebSocket-Protocol` against the offers it sent and fails with `Server sent an invalid subprotocol`, naming neither the protocol nor the member, so a case asserting Novis's own wording against a live origin fails on a refusal that was correct. Assert that wording of `transport::settled` directly — the judgement `openSocket`'s scripted arm reaches — and assert of the live `101` only that it was refused.
